steps.text: Bring a rope and a shovel.
steps.source: Required Equipment: Rope. (The Mount Sternum way is newer than 7.1: this draft goes through the Pick 'N Shovel mine, like the Crusader Helmet draft.)

steps.text: Dig the loose stone pile west of Kazordoon open with your shovel and go down.
steps.source: The wiki goes through Mount Sternum, which came later; on the 7.1 map the dwarf geomancers are deep in the mines below Kazordoon's west side.

steps.text: Go east, up with your rope and down again into the mines (minotaurs, dwarves).
steps.source: Follow this path past the Graveyard of the Doomed to the west and north and go down a level.

steps.text: Follow the mines down, floor after floor, to the bottom (dwarf soldiers and guards).
steps.source: Head directly north west and go down the hole. Move north and take first west and go down the hole.

steps.text: Fight through the dwarf guards and soldiers to the geomancers (kill them first).
steps.source: The quest box is on the east side of this room, behind a couple Dwarf Guards, and a Dwarf Geomancer.

steps.text: Needs placing: the box with a dwarven ring, a small diamond and a small sapphire (east side of the geomancers' room on the wiki; not on the 7.1 map).
steps.source: The quest box is on the east side of this room.
